Date of service: 07/16/2025 | Dr. Jasper Iverson, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
41-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2019, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: type 2 diabetes, hyperlipidemia.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 15 mg weekly for 24 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, DAS28-CRP 5.3 (high disease activity).
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
